Text:
[II] Let us always give thanks to Christ, our leader and teacher. He came to do good and serve us all. Therefore, with humility and confidence, let us ask Him:
[IR] Lord, be with Your family.
[I1] Be present, Lord, with the leaders of Your Church as they share in Your mission. Help them shepherd and lead,
[I2] together with You, all people to the Father.
[I1] Send Your angels to accompany us on our journeys,
[I2] to help us avoid what might ensnare our bodies and souls.
[I1] Teach us, by Your example, to serve one another,
[I2] for You came to serve, not to be served.
[I1] Within every community, may we find help from our siblings in Christ
[I2] so that, together with Your presence, our faith will be strengthened.
[I1] Have mercy on all the deceased,
[I2] welcoming them into the light of Your presence.
Changes: 2026-02-28 - Paul Prins: Initial translation of these intentions.
